name: AI Agents Map
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: The AI setup on this computer as cards and a map, in an app window: coding agents with plan, limits and usage, local LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Jan, KoboldCpp) and their models, MCP servers and skills. Connect them by drawing a line, with a preview and Undo; see what each agent still needs; start agents in a terminal inside it; install local LLMs and models, which start and stop with their agents. 8 languages.
